messages.subject: Extract raw copy numbers
parts:
Hi,

I have run the Total Copy Number Analysis on 96 SNP6.0 arrays and I
end up with a CnChipEffectSet.

> print(cesN)
CnChipEffectSet:
Name: TRIBE
Tags: ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-XY
Path: plmData/TRIBE,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300,A+B,FLN,-XY/GenomeWideSNP_6
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,monocell
Number of arrays: 96
Names: TRIBE_A01_155716, TRIBE_A02_155732, ..., TRIBE_H12_155906
Time period: 2008-04-08 12:10:06 -- 2008-04-08 12:10:20
Total file size: 2587.13MB
RAM: 0.13MB
Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm", mergeStrands: logi TRUE,
combineAlleles: logi TRUE)

I'd like to extract all raw copy number values (that is, the signal
after removal of all effects, before segmentation) for all the chips
including normals, in order to export them. What would be the proper
way to do this?
Ideally I don't want to use a common reference before that step
because I don't have case-control pairs of samples and the number of
normal samples will be reduced and may vary from batch to batch so I'd
prefer to use a reference that would be the robust average across
normal samples, once I have extracted the values.

I have seen that it's also possible to run
rawCNs <- extractRawCopyNumbers(cbs, array=1, chromosome=1)
but apparently, the common reference is by default calculated as the
robust average across samples, which is a step I would prefer to deal
with later as explained above.

Thank you so much for your answers,
Nicolas

In order to to calculate copy numbers you need to have a reference,
i.e. raw CN are defined as log2(theta/thetaR) and you need the
'thetaR' part. If you only want to extract the 'theta', that is, the
chip effects, you can use extractMatrix() or extractDataFrame(), e.g.

# Identify units on Chr22
cdf <- getCdf(cesN);
gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf);
units <- getUnitsOnChromosome(gi, 22);

# Extract theta:s for Chr22
theta <- extractTheta(cesN, units=units);

# Extract the same with additional annotation
data <- extractDataFrame(cesN, units=units, addNames=TRUE);

If you use 'units=NULL', all units will be returned.

/Henrik

>
> Thank you so much for your answers,
> Nicolas
